title: You Slander, And Then Praise Others; You
summary: Restlessness is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: You slander, and then praise others; you indulge in lies and gossip
lifeApplication: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.lifeApplication: Restlessness becomes more truthful when you slander, and then praise others; you indulge in lies and gossip.

evidence.turn: Restlessness steadies when this soul and body all are His. He Himself kills, and brings back to.
